title: Operations & HR Administrator
description:
Part-Time 18 Hours per Week 3 Days per Week 9:00am - 3:00pm

Are you an organised and proactive administrator who enjoys supporting people and keeping a busy business running smoothly?

Our client is a growing and ambitious business seeking an Operations & HR Administrator to join their head office team on a part-time basis. This is a varied and rewarding opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys balancing people-focused responsibilities with operational administration.

Working closely with senior leadership, you will play a key role in supporting recruitment, employee administration, payroll preparation, compliance activities and the day-to-day coordination of business operations.

The Role

This is a diverse position where no two days are the same. Responsibilities will include:
- Coordinating recruitment administration and candidate communications.
- Preparing employment contracts and onboarding documentation.
- Supporting new starter onboarding processes.
- Maintaining accurate employee records and personnel files.
- Preparing payroll information for processing.
- Managing holiday, absence and employee administration records.
- Maintaining compliance and business documentation.
- Providing general administrative support across the wider business.
- Assisting with operational projects and ad hoc administrative tasks.

About You

We are looking for an individual who is:
- Highly organised with excellent attention to detail.
- Reliable, professional and able to maintain confidentiality.
- Comfortable managing multiple priorities and deadlines.
- Confident communicating with colleagues at all levels.
- Self-motivated and capable of working independently.
- Proactive in identifying improvements and solving problems.
- Passionate about supporting a growing and evolving business.

Previous experience within administration, HR support, office coordination or business support would be advantageous; however, attitude, organisation and a willingness to learn are equally important.

What's on Offer?
- Part-time position, 18 hours per week.
- Three-day working week.
- Fixed working pattern of 9:00am to 3:00pm.
- A varied role with exposure to people, operations and business administration.
- Opportunity to make a genuine impact within a growing organisation.
- Supportive and collaborative working environment.
- Long-term opportunity to develop alongside the business.

If you are a highly organised administrator who enjoys bringing structure, efficiency and support to a busy operation, we would love to hear from you.

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Hereford Full-Time £32,000-£36,000 FTE

The Opportunity

An established multi-site business is seeking a highly organised and experienced Book-Keeper / Senior Finance Assistant to join its Head Office finance team.

This is a hands-on position responsible for ensuring the smooth day-to-day running of the transactional finance function. The successful candidate will play a key role in maintaining accurate financial records, supporting month-end activities and ensuring finance processes are completed accurately and efficiently.

This opportunity offers flexibility, with both full-time and part-time applicants considered. For this organisation, finding the right individual is more important than a rigid working pattern.

In addition to managing the transactional finance workload, you will take responsibility for coordinating and supporting a junior member of the team, helping to create an efficient, well-organised and collaborative finance function.

Key Responsibilities
- Managing purchase ledger activities and supplier invoice processing.
- Ensuring accurate coding of expenditure and financial transactions.
- Completing supplier statement reconciliations.
- Performing bank and account reconciliations.
- Resolving invoice discrepancies, supplier queries and credit note issues.
- Preparing payment runs and maintaining payment schedules.
- Maintaining accurate supplier and financial records.
- Ensuring all transactional processing is completed in a timely manner to support month-end deadlines.
- Liaising with external finance partners and internal stakeholders.
- Identifying opportunities to improve finance processes and controls.
- Supporting the implementation of more efficient systems and ways of working.
- Coordinating the day-to-day workload of a junior finance team member.
- Delegating tasks effectively and monitoring completion.
- Providing guidance, support and ongoing development to less experienced colleagues.

About You

We are looking for an individual who combines strong accounts experience with excellent organisation and communication skills.

You will ideally have:
- Previous bookkeeping, purchase ledger or accounts administration experience.
- Strong understanding of transactional finance processes.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- The ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines consistently.
- Confidence in reviewing work and providing support to junior colleagues.
- Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
- Experience using accounting software and Excel.
- A proactive approach to problem-solving and process improvement.
- High levels of professionalism, discretion and accountability.

Experience within a multi-site business environment would be advantageous but is not essential.

What's on Offer?
- Salary of £32,000-£36,000 FTE, depending on experience.
- Full-time or part-time working options available.
- Minimum commitment of three days per week.
- A varied and autonomous role with genuine responsibility.
- Opportunity to help shape and improve finance processes.
- Supportive and collaborative working environment.
- Long-term career development within a growing organisation.

If you are an organised finance professional who enjoys taking ownership, improving processes and supporting others to succeed, we would be delighted to hear from you.

title: Personal Assistant
description:
Personal Assistant to Managing Director
Location: Hereford
Salary: Up to £35,000 per annum
Working Pattern: Full-time, Monday to Friday, 5 days on-site
Employment Type: Permanent
The Opportunity We're recruiting for a Personal Assistant to support the Managing Director of a growing IT Services business based in Hereford.
Our client is an established technology services provider continuing to expand its customer base and operations. As the business grows, they're looking for an organised, proactive and commercially aware PA who can work closely with the MD, helping manage their workload, coordinate business activities and ensure day-to-day operations run smoothly.
This is more than a traditional administrative position. You'll become a trusted point of contact for the MD, helping manage competing priorities, supporting business projects and ensuring important actions are followed through.
It's an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys taking ownership, working independently and being involved in different areas of a growing business.
Key Responsibilities
- Provide comprehensive PA and administrative support to the Managing Director.
- Manage diaries, meetings, appointments and travel arrangements, ensuring the MD's time is used effectively.
- Act as a key point of contact for internal teams, customers and external stakeholders.
- Manage correspondence, emails and communications on behalf of the MD.
- Prepare reports, presentations, meeting agendas and business documentation.
- Coordinate meetings, capture actions and follow up with relevant stakeholders to ensure deadlines are met.
- Support the coordination of internal projects and wider business improvement initiatives.
- Assist with confidential business information, commercial documentation and administrative processes.
- Work closely with department managers to coordinate priorities and improve communication across the business.
- Identify opportunities to improve administrative processes and support the continued growth of the organisation.

What We're Looking For
- Previous experience as a Personal Assistant, Executive Assistant, Office Manager or in a similar senior administrative role.
- Experience supporting a Managing Director, senior leader or management team.
- Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and competing deadlines.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with confidence engaging with stakeholders at all levels.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
- A proactive approach, with the confidence to work independently and take ownership of tasks.
- Strong attention to detail and the ability to handle confidential information professionally.
- Comfortable working in a growing business where priorities can change quickly.

Experience within IT Services, Managed Services or another technical environment would be advantageous, although this isn't essential.
Why Consider This Opportunity?
- Work directly with the Managing Director of a growing technology business.
- Gain exposure to business operations, commercial activities and strategic projects.
- Take ownership of a varied role with genuine responsibility.
- Join an established organisation with ambitious plans for continued growth.
- Opportunity to develop the position as the business expands.

Interested? If you're an experienced PA or EA looking for a varied position where you can make a genuine difference to a growing business, we'd be keen to hear from you.

title: Logistics Coordinator
description:
We're recruiting for an experienced Logistics Coordinator to join an established manufacturing business, taking responsibility for international shipments, import and export compliance, freight management and logistics processes.

This is a varied role where you'll work closely with internal teams, suppliers and external logistics providers to ensure goods move efficiently, cost-effectively and in line with relevant customs regulations.

We're looking for someone who has a good understanding of international shipping procedures, enjoys problem-solving and takes pride in keeping operations organised and compliant.

Key Responsibilities
- Coordinate import and export activities, ensuring customs documentation is accurate and compliant.
- Manage shipping paperwork, commodity codes, rules of origin and supplier declarations.
- Liaise with freight forwarders, carriers and customs agents to ensure smooth movement of goods.
- Monitor freight costs, delivery performance and logistics KPIs, identifying opportunities for improvement.
- Resolve shipping queries, customs issues and delivery discrepancies.
- Maintain accurate records and documentation in line with HMRC and international trade requirements.
- Work closely with warehouse, purchasing and customer service teams to support efficient operations.
- Review logistics processes, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, reduce costs and strengthen compliance.

About You
- Previous experience in logistics, imports, exports or international shipping.
- Good understanding of UK customs procedures and import/export documentation.
- Experience working with freight forwarders, shipping providers and customs agents.
- Knowledge of commodity codes, rules of origin and customs compliance.
- Confident using ERP systems, Microsoft Excel and maintaining accurate records.
- Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities.
- A proactive approach with excellent communication and problem-solving skills.

Experience with customs systems, duty relief procedures or international trade compliance would be advantageous.

The Opportunity

This is a great opportunity to take ownership of an important logistics function within an established business, helping improve processes, manage international freight operations and contribute to continued operational efficiency.

Interested? Contact Headturner Search for further information or a confidential discussion.

title: Administrative Assistant
description: We reserve the right to close this vacancy early if we receive sufficient applications for the role. Therefore, if you are interested, please submit your application as early as possible. Taurus Healthcare is looking for an organised, proactive and compassionate Administrative Assistant to support the delivery of high-quality healthcare services across our growing portfolio of NHS services. This is a varied and rewarding role where no two days are the same. You will work closely with operational managers, clinicians and healthcare teams, providing administrative and secretarialsupport that helps ensure patients receive timely, safe and effective care As an Administrative Assistant, you will play a key role in supporting day-to-day operations, managing appointment systems, coordinating referrals, maintaining records and assisting with service performance activities. You will be a central point of contact for patients, GP practices, clinicians and external stakeholders, helping services run efficiently and delivering an excellent patient experience Key Responsibilities Managing and maintaining appointment books and clinic schedules using systems such as EMIS. Booking, amending and cancelling patient appointments. Supporting referral management and ensuring timely action of incoming referrals. Maintaining accurate patient and operational records. Assisting with rota administration and identifying staffing gaps. Supporting data collection, reporting and KPI monitoring. Assisting with complaints, incidents and governance processes. Managing operational enquiries via telephone and email. Supporting meeting administration, action logs, diaries and team activities. Assisting with staff onboarding and induction processes. Contributing to audits, quality assurance and service improvement activities. Supporting stock control and equipment records We are seeking someone who is highly organised, detail-focused and confident working in a busy healthcare environment. JOB PURPOSE: To provide administrative support to the Operational Team within Taurus Healthcare. To assist and support the management team with operational requirements and provide telephone answering services within the office environment. To ensure all documentation is complete, appropriate, accurate and fit for purpose. Main Responsibilities: To have general knowledge of all Taurus services, to be able to cover for annual leave, sickness and unplanned absences with other administrators in the Operations team. Contribute to the monitoring and fulfilment of the clinical and non-clinical rotas. Ensure that required information is accurately entered onto internal systems. Maintain and update medical records, ensuring accuracy and confidentiality. To assist with stock control and ordering of non-clinical items for all services within operational team.( clinical consumables) Review the action log and address any tasks required, documenting what action has been taken and when this is complete. Contribute to meeting the standards required by external and internal audits To assist with the process of collecting data for contractual key performers indicators. Collect, collate, process and present operational and clinical information for audit purposes. To support the wider team with logging, documenting and investigating service complaints and incidents received this to include reporting for the monthly performance report. To ensure that any risks that are identified are immediately reported to the appropriate manager. Effective use of operational software including adastra, Emis, When I work, hero health, AccuRx, Microsoft office,survey monkey and relevant others. To support the process of mandatory training recording and reporting.. Utilise medical records e.g EMIS and Adastra to support operational administrative tasks, including appointment management, patient registration. To ensure medical equipment asset register is up to date including recording calibrations, returns of items in warranty and decommissioned items. To ensure all appointment books are uploaded onto EMIS in advance e.g. 6 weeks and are correctly assigned to the right clinician, location and with the correct slot types. Proactively manage clinicians' appointment books and clinic templates Book, amend, and cancel patient appointments using electronic booking systems e.g., EMIS. Coordinate with clinicians and service managers to ensure clinic schedules are accurate and up to date. Monitor and manage appointment book capacity to ensure optimal patient flow. Liaise with patients to confirm appointments, provide instructions, and manage rescheduling as needed. Anticipate and resolve booking conflicts or appointment overlaps in collaboration with clinicians and operation service managers Support the coordination of urgent or short-notice appointments as required. Track referral and action as necessary based on urgency escalate any risks to service managers. Generate referrals following guidance from referring clinician Manage the operational phone line, dealing with enquiries and sign positing and escalating as appropriate. This will include GP practices, members of the public, patients and other agencies. Act as the first point of contact for queries from patients, relatives, and external providers. Communicate changes to appointments or schedules in a timely and sensitive manner. Support the timely management of incoming referrals and ensure they are actioned appropriately Utilising electronic sources to communicate on service feedback with patients e.g. survey monkey and gaining consent where required Utilising software to generate reports on patient feedback To support operational managers with day to day operational activity including (but not limited to) daily communications, organising staff appraisal, one to ones, resource sheets / allocation, meeting and diary requests, action logs, collating information for agendas for meetings and any other duties as required Identifying and rectifying rota gaps (including liaising with clinical and non clinical agencies for cover). Supporting Operational Managers with new starter induction processes (may include creating accounts on EMIS and TeamNet). Manage all patient referrals undertaken Provide a calm, empathetic, and professional response when dealing with distressed, anxious, or upset patients and their families. Communicate sensitive information clearly and compassionately, particularly regarding appointment delays, cancellations, Use discretion and emotional intelligence to de-escalate challenging situations while maintaining service professionalism and patient dignity. Escalate concerns appropriately to clinical staff or management where additional support is required. Maintain strict patient confidentiality at all times, especially in emotionally charged or sensitive discussions. *A full Job Description & Person Specification is attached to this advert*
